name: Danny Deleon
lede: Afro, Soulful and Deep House from New York. Founder of Dandelion Musica.
bioShort: Danny Deleon is a New York DJ and producer working the warm side of house music: Afro, Soulful, Deep and Latin grooves built for the dancefloor.
bioLong: Danny Deleon has been behind the decks since 2012, coming up in New York's house scene and building sets that move between Afro percussion, soulful vocals and deep, rolling basslines.

In 2021 he started producing his own records, and in 2024 he founded Dandelion Musica, an independent label for Soulful, Afro, Deep, Latin and Tech House. His releases and remixes sell on Traxsource and Beatport, and Shine (Richie Dio Remix) reached #9 on Traxsource's Afro House chart on pre-order.
He releases new music every month and plays across New York, from club nights to open-air and cultural celebrations.
